title: Ozzy Croatian Linguine Pasta
description: A buttery, glassy-jelly linguine dish infused with shio-koji, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Fill a pot with 4 cups of water, add 2g salt, and bring to a rolling boil.
Add linguine pasta and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally until al dente, then drain and reserve 1 cup of pasta water.
In a skillet, heat 5ml vegetable oil over medium heat, then melt 30g butter.
Stir in 20g shio-koji paste until fragrant and the butter turns golden.
Pour 400ml low-sodium chicken broth into the skillet and bring to a gentle simmer.
Whisk in 100ml heavy cream and 15ml lemon juice, then reduce heat and let the sauce thicken to a glossy glaze.
Toss the drained linguine into the skillet, adding reserved pasta water as needed to coat each strand evenly.
Finish with 10g chopped parsley and 1g black pepper, serve immediately.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
